rules.singleCase: Sufficient for case-specific Learning. Insufficient for generalized Learning.
rules.repeatedConsistent: Same family, supported status, no mixed statuses, total >= 2. May strengthen evidenceStrength to strong. Generalized Outcome Learning still requires causal support.
rules.repeatedMixed: Conflicting or mixed statuses across history. Not cherry-picked. Not promotion-eligible as generalized.
rules.insufficientHistory: Inconclusive with no prior supported history.

cases.AD: repeated-consistent strengthens only by explicit rules
